summary: Focused frontend test on new PricingPanel (4-row breakdown) across all 11 calculators + Re-quote button in QuoteDetailDialog. Login (admin@printandsave.ca) OK. All 11 calculators (Paper, Booklet, Stickers, Large Format, Laser, Direct Print, Channel Letters, DTF, Embroidery, Sublimation, Roll Stickers) after Calculate show pricing-panel with all four rows (price-production, price-retail, price-wholesale, price-order-total). My Quotes: clicking quote-row opens quote-detail-dialog with all 4 pricing rows + requote-button; email-quote click does NOT open the detail dialog (row-click isolation working). Catalog: clicking catalog-row opens dialog with pricing-panel + requote-button and Re-quote navigates to the matching module route AND closes the dialog. Only defect: catalog dialog's PricingPanel only shows Retail + Order Total rows (missing Production Cost and Wholesale Price) because Catalog quote summaries do not carry base_cost / wholesale_total.

minor.issue: Catalog quote summary is missing base_cost and wholesale_total, so admin sees only 2 of the 4 required rows (Retail + Order Total) in the catalog detail dialog. Spec requires all 4 rows visible for admin.

ui_bugs.issue: PricingPanel is missing price-production and price-wholesale rows for catalog entries. Root cause is upstream data (quote.summary.total lacks base_cost/wholesale_total). PricingPanel itself renders correctly when data is present (confirmed via My Quotes).

action_items: Populate catalog quote.summary (or quote.summary.total) with base_cost and wholesale_total (and unit_price/wholesale_unit) so admin sees the full 4-row breakdown in the catalog detail dialog. Either enrich catalog docs at seed/build time or have backend project full pricing fields when returning catalog rows.
critical_code_review_comments: PricingPanel gates rows on `!= null`; that's correct — the missing rows for catalog are strictly a data issue, not a UI bug.
QuoteDetailDialog uses `quote.summary?.total || quote.summary` for pricing; consistent, no change needed.
Re-quote navigation uses MODULE_ROUTES map keyed by human module labels; covers all 11 modules present in seed data.

success_rate.frontend: 11/11 calculators + Quotes dialog fully pass; Catalog dialog partially passes (2/4 rows) => ~95%

context_for_next_testing_agent: All 11 calculator modules and My Quotes flow are 100% verified for the new PricingPanel + Re-quote. Only remaining item: catalog quote summaries lack base_cost & wholesale_total so admin only sees Retail + Order Total in the catalog detail dialog. After main agent enriches catalog data, retest only /catalog -> click catalog-row -> confirm all 4 price rows visible; other flows already good.
rca of the issue: PricingPanel conditionally renders each row using `!= null` on r.base_cost / r.wholesale_total. For catalog entries (`/catalog` -> catalog-row click -> QuoteDetailDialog), `quote.summary.total` (or `quote.summary`) only contains retail_total (and hence order total falls back to retail). Neither base_cost nor wholesale_total is stored in the catalog documents, so those rows are simply not rendered. My Quotes rows include the full fields (confirmed: all 4 rows visible), so the divergence is data-only. Fix: enrich catalog quote summaries with base_cost, wholesale_total, unit_price, wholesale_unit at seed/build time or projection layer.
